criteria: Radical wing of the French Revolution acting in 1789-1799: Jacobin Club members and leaders, Montagnards (the Mountain) and members of the Committee of Public Safety, Cordeliers and Hebertists, Enrages, radical Paris Commune officials, and Babeuf's Conspiracy of the Equals. Girondins, Feuillants, moderates, royalists, generals without a radical political role, Napoleon, and nineteenth-century figures (Blanqui, Communards) are excluded unless they acted in the 1789-1799 radical camp.
